get.description: Read a page of meetings. Control what is returned via the `properties` query param.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. patch.description: Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{meetingId}`or optionally a unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. `{meetingId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, and the `idProperty` query param refers to a property whose values are unique for the object. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will result in an error. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

properties.description: An object containing key-value pairs where each key is a property name and the value is the property's value. All properties are strings.

schema.description: Represents the input required to update a CRM object, containing an object with property names and their corresponding values.

archived.description: A boolean indicating whether this object is archived.

archivedAt.description: The date and time when this object was archived, in ISO 8601 format.

createdAt.description: The date and time when this object was created, in ISO 8601 format.

id.description: The unique identifier for this object, represented as a string.

objectWriteTraceId.description: A string used to trace the write operations for this object.

properties.description: A map of property names to their values, where each value is a string.

sourceId.description: The identifier of the source from which the value was obtained. It is a string.

sourceLabel.description: A label describing the source from which the value was obtained. It is a string.

sourceType.description: The type of source from which the value was obtained. It is a string.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the value was recorded, in ISO 8601 format.

updatedByUserId.description: The ID of the user who updated the value. It is an integer.

value.description: The value associated with the timestamp. It is a string.

items.description: Property model that includes timestamp.

propertiesWithHistory.description: A map of property names to arrays of historical values, each containing a value and its associated timestamp.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when this object was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

url.description: A string representing the URL of this object.

warnings.description: An array of warnings related to this object, each containing a category, message, and context.

category.description: A string indicating the category of the warning.

context.description: An object providing additional context about the warning, with properties as key-value pairs where both keys and values are strings.

message.description: A string containing the warning message.

items.description: Represents a warning message related to a public object in HubSpot, providing details about the nature and context of the warning.

get.description: List all associations of an object by object type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations for a specific object, identified by its type and ID, with another specified object type. The maximum number of associations that can be retrieved per call is 500.

parameters.name: toObjectType
parameters.description: The type of the object to which associations are being listed.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

after.description: A string token that indicates the position after the last item in the current page of results. This token is used to retrieve the next page.

link.description: A URL string that provides a direct link to the next page of results.

next.description: Specifies the paging information needed to retrieve the next set of results in a paginated API response

paging.description: Paging information for forward-only pagination. Contains the next page reference when more results are available; omitted or empty on the last page.

results.description: An array of objects, each representing an association with multiple labels. Each object contains details about the associated object and the types of associations.

associationTypes.description: An array of association specifications with labels, detailing the types of associations between the objects.

category.description: The category of the association. Valid values include 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', 'USER_DEFINED', 'INTEGRATOR_DEFINED', and 'WORK'.

fromObjectTypeId.description: The object type ID of the source object in the association.

label.description: A string label for the association, providing a human-readable description.

toObjectTypeId.description: The object type ID of the target object in the association.

typeId.description: An integer representing the unique identifier for the type of association.

items.description: Defines the type, direction, and details of the relationship between two CRM objects.

toObjectId.description: The unique identifier of the target object to which associations are made. It is a string.

items.description: Represents an object that is associated with multiple other objects, with optional context.

schema.description: Represents a paginated collection of objects that are associated with multiple labels, including the results and pagination details. This component is used when retrieving associated objects with specific labels in a forward-paging manner.
